question: If x − (1)/(x) = 3, the value of x³ − (1)/(x³) is
solution:
**Given:**

x - 1/x = 3

**Concept used:**

a³ - b³ = (a - b)³ + 3ab(a - b)

**Calculation:**

x³ - 1/x³ = (x - 1/x)³ + 3 × x × 1/x × (x - 1/x)

⇒ (x - 1/x)3 + 3(x - 1/x)

⇒ (3)³ + 3 × (3)

⇒ 27 + 9 = 36

**∴ The value of x³ - 1/x³ is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** If x - 1/x = a, then x³ - 1/x³ = a³ + 3a

Here a = 3

x - 1/x³ = 3³ + 3 × 3

= 27 + 9

= 36
